readings.title: Thanksgiving for Creation and Exodus
readings.subtitle: A responsive call to give thanks for His everlasting loving-commitment in creation and deliverance.

readings.title: Thanksgiving for Conquest and Provision
readings.subtitle: Recounting His victory over sovereigns and His faithful provision for all flesh.

readings.title: Trust in the Everlasting King
readings.subtitle: Praise to the everlasting King who helps the oppressed and reigns forever, unlike the fleeting princes of man.
readings.text:
[Psalm 146:1] Praise Yah! Praise <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, O my being!
[2] While I live I praise <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; I sing praises to my <dn>Elohim</dn> while I exist.
[3] Do not put your trust in princes, In a son of man, in whom is no deliverance.
[4] <dn>His</dn> spirit goes out, he returns to his earth; In that day his plans perish.
[5] Blessed is he who has the <dn>Ěl</dn> of Ya‛aqoḇ for his help, Whose expectancy is in <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> his <dn>Elohim</dn>,
[6] Maker of the heavens and earth, <dn>את</dn> The sea and <dn>את</dn> all that is in them, Who is guarding truth forever,
[7] Doing right-ruling for the oppressed, Giving bread to the hungry. <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> releases those who are bound,
[8] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> opens the eyes of the blind, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> raises those who are bowed down, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> loves the righteous.
[9] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> guards <dn>את</dn> the strangers, <dn>He</dn> lifts up the fatherless and widow, But the way of the wrong ones <dn>He</dn> turns upside down.
[10] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> reigns forever, O Tsiyon, Your <dn>Elohim</dn> to all generations. Praise Yah!

readings.title: Praise for Restoration and the Power of His Word
readings.subtitle: He builds up Yerushalayim, heals the broken-hearted, commands nature, and gives His laws to Yisra’ěl.
readings.text:
[Psalm 147:1] Praise Yah! For it is good to sing praises to our <dn>Elohim</dn>. For it is pleasant – praise is fitting.
[2] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> builds up Yerushalayim, <dn>He</dn> gathers the outcasts of Yisra’ěl –
[3] <dn>He</dn> heals the broken-hearted And binds up their wounds.
[4] <dn>He</dn> appoints the number of the stars, <dn>He</dn> gives names to all of them.
[5] Great is our Master and mighty in power, There is no limit to <dn>His</dn> understanding.
[6] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> lifts up the meek ones, <dn>He</dn> throws the wrong ones down to the ground.
[7] Respond to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with thanksgiving; Sing praises on a lyre to our <dn>Elohim</dn>,
[8] Who covers the heavens with clouds, Who prepares rain for the earth, Who makes grass to sprout on the mountains,
[9] Giving to the beast its food, To the young ravens that cry.
[10] <dn>He</dn> does not delight in the strength of the horse, <dn>He</dn> takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
[11] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> takes pleasure in those who fear <dn>Him</dn>, In those who wait for <dn>His</dn> loving-commitment.
[12] Extol <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, O Yerushalayim! Praise your <dn>Elohim</dn>, O Tsiyon!
[13] For <dn>He</dn> has strengthened the bars of your gates, <dn>He</dn> has blessed your children in your midst,
[14] Who makes peace in your borders, <dn>He</dn> satisfies you with the finest wheat;
[15] Who sends out <dn>His</dn> command to the earth, <dn>His</dn> word runs very speedily;
[16] Who gives snow like wool, <dn>He</dn> scatters the frost like ashes;
[17] Throwing out <dn>His</dn> hail like pieces; Who does stand before <dn>His</dn> cold?
[18] <dn>He</dn> sends out <dn>His</dn> word and melts them, <dn>He</dn> causes <dn>His</dn> wind to blow – the waters flow;
[19] Declaring <dn>His</dn> Word to Ya‛aqoḇ, <dn>His</dn> laws and <dn>His</dn> right-rulings to Yisra’ěl.
[20] <dn>He</dn> has not done so with any nation; And they have not known <dn>His</dn> right-rulings! Praise Yah!

readings.title: A Universal Call to Praise
readings.subtitle: All of creation, from the heavens above to the earth below, is summoned to praise the Name of YeHoVaH.
readings.text:
[Psalm 148:1] Praise Yah! Praise <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> from the heavens, Praise <dn>Him</dn> in the heights!
[2] Praise <dn>Him</dn>, all <dn>His</dn> messengers; Praise <dn>Him</dn>, all <dn>His</dn> hosts!
[3] Praise <dn>Him</dn>, sun and moon; Praise <dn>Him</dn>, all you stars of light!
[4] Praise <dn>Him</dn>, heavens of heavens, And you waters above the heavens!
[5] Let them praise <dn>את</dn> the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, For <dn>He</dn> commanded and they were created.
[6] And <dn>He</dn> established them forever and ever, <dn>He</dn> gave a law and they pass not beyond.
[7] Praise <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> from the earth, You great sea creatures and all the depths,
[8] Fire and hail, snow and clouds, Stormy wind that does <dn>His</dn> word,
[9] The mountains and all hills, Fruit tree and all cedars,
[10] Wild beasts and all cattle, Creeping creatures and flying birds,
[11] Sovereigns of the earth and all peoples, Rulers and all judges of the earth,
[12] Both young men and maidens, Old men and children.
[13] Let them praise <dn>את</dn> the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, For <dn>His</dn> Name alone is exalted, <dn>His</dn> splendour is above the earth and heavens.
[14] <dn>He</dn> also lifts up the horn of <dn>His</dn> people, The praise of all <dn>His</dn> lovingly-committed ones; Of the children of Yisra’ěl, A people near to <dn>Him</dn>. Praise Yah!

readings.title: The Victorious and Final Doxology
readings.subtitle: The lovingly-committed ones rejoice in their Maker, executing written right-ruling, and all that has breath praises Yah.
readings.text:
[Psalm 149:1] Praise Yah! Sing to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> a new song, <dn>His</dn> praise in an assembly of lovingly-committed ones.
[2] Let Yisra’ěl rejoice in their Maker; Let the children of Tsiyon exult in their Sovereign.
[3] Let them praise <dn>His</dn> Name in a dance; Let them sing praises to <dn>Him</dn> with the tambourine and lyre.
[4] For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> takes pleasure in <dn>His</dn> people; <dn>He</dn> embellishes the meek ones with deliverance.
[5] Let the lovingly-committed ones exult in esteem; Let them sing aloud on their beds.
[6] Let the exaltation of <dn>Ěl</dn> be in their mouth, And a two-edged sword in their hand,
[7] To execute vengeance on the nations, Punishments on the peoples;
[8] To bind their sovereigns with chains, And their nobles with iron bands;
[9] To execute on them the written right-ruling; A splendour it is for all <dn>His</dn> lovingly-committed ones. Praise Yah!
[Psalm 150:1] Praise Yah! Praise <dn>Ěl</dn> in <dn>His</dn> set-apart place; Praise <dn>Him</dn> in <dn>His</dn> mighty expanse!
[2] Praise <dn>Him</dn> for <dn>His</dn> mighty acts; Praise <dn>Him</dn> according to <dn>His</dn> excellent greatness!
[3] Praise <dn>Him</dn> with the blowing of a shophar; Praise <dn>Him</dn> with the harp and lyre!
[4] Praise <dn>Him</dn> with tambourine and dance; Praise <dn>Him</dn> with stringed instruments and flutes!
[5] Praise <dn>Him</dn> with sounding cymbals; Praise <dn>Him</dn> with resounding cymbals!
[6] Let all that has breath praise YaH. Praise YaH!
